liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Comes A Time** (4 reviews): Comes A Time was a surprise, followed by trancy drums featuring Hamza; Comes A Time was a surprise, and the band played it well [14][15][16][17]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Jack Straw's opening notes made a strong impression, signaling the band was in strong form; Phil's bombs in Jack Straw and Jerry's heartfelt vocals set the tone for the evening [19][21]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): Loose Lucy got the whole crowd dancing along [14]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Estimated Prophet had the room spinning; the stage rotated in sync, with lights and knobs on Weir's rack [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Comes A Time**: back after 277 archived shows (1268 days) [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-12-27.127387.nak300.bowen.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 162 min [1]. Said about its sound: First set may have mixing fluctuations as the taper adjusted the center mic [1]
- **gd90-12-27.set1-akg-set2-sbd.miller.21928.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 173 min; rated 3.5/5 by 10 [3]
- **gd1990-12-27.164129.UltraMatrix.sbd.air-check.cm.miller.f.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 170 min [4]
- **gd1990-12-27.aud-sbd.tumolo.miller.tetzeli.fix-21928.76115.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 173 min [7]
- **gd1990-12-27.set2-fixed.sbd.8193.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 12 songs; 105 min [11]
- **gd90-12-27.fob-akg-mahoney-oneill.miller.28385.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 11 songs; 104 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [12]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is full and upfront, stronger in left channel, suggesting taping on Phil's side at an angle [17]

## Around the show

- Hamza El Din joined the band; the recording has left-right panning [16]
- Reviewer's first show after Mydland's death, and first time hearing Comes A Time [19]
- A traveling companion paid $175 for a ticket to the 31st show; the reviewer had none [20]
- Hamza el Din chanted Olin Arageed with Mickey during drums [23]
- Hamza El Din appeared during Drums, which the taper found awesome [1]
- The show served as a test run for the New Year's Eve broadcast, with Hamza El Din on percussion [4]
- A pause between Hamza el Din and Space came from equipment being plugged in [11]
- Reviewer rates it the best show they had heard since 12/28/89 [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-12-27.127387.nak300.bowen.flac16**: taped by Jeff Bowen; transferred by Jeff Bowen; source: Source: Nakamichi CM-300x3; 2 CP-4 Shotgun Capsules + 1 CP-1; Cardioid Capsule > Boss BX-4 Mixer > Sony WM-D6C (MX-S 100 Masters); [1]. Also: Taper believes this was the first time using the Nakamichi three-mic mix for recording [1]
- **gd90-12-27.set1-akg-set2-sbd.miller.21928.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Paul Tumolo; transferred by Charlie Miller and Neil Sturtevant; source: Soundboard and Audience Composite [3]. Also: Reviewer notes other audience sources cover only the second set and requests a separate first-set audience upload [21]
- **gd1990-12-27.164129.UltraMatrix.sbd.air-check.cm.miller.f.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 16, 2023; source: Ultramatrix SBD (In-House Broadcast) > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK SA-X100) [4]. Also: Tape was labeled Air Check AD-DA, patched from a Sony PCM recording rig; tape flips covered by ultramatrix cassette [4]
- **gd1990-12-27.aud-sbd.tumolo.miller.tetzeli.fix-21928.76115.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 21928 [7]. Also: A gap in Space was patched using the audience source shnid 28385; a right-channel gap was fixed with left channel [7]
- **gd1990-12-27.set2-fixed.sbd.8193.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Tony Gardner; source: SBD(matrix)>DAT>CDR [11]. Also: Ultra-Matrix mix kept audience microphones on all show, making it a soundboard plus audience blend [11]
- **gd90-12-27.fob-akg-mahoney-oneill.miller.28385.sbeok.shnf**: taped by JC Mahoney, Dan O'Neill; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Audience: AKG 461's [12]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 27, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/december-27-1990) [27]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 28, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/december-28-1990) [28]
